objective: Measure how calibration dataset choice affects simulated PTQ classification accuracy on sklearn digits.

agent_runs.notes: Implemented and ran simulated PTQ experiment.

summary: FP32 test accuracy was 0.9733. Non-pathological 8-bit calibration variants matched FP32, while non-pathological 4-bit variants ranged from 0.9622 to 0.9689. A pathological blank calibration set collapsed both bit widths to 0.0978.
next_actions: Repeat random calibration sampling to estimate variance.
Repeat with a production quantization backend.
